title: Multiple Meanings of Put
focus: Diferenciar os vários sentidos dos phrasal verbs com put pelo contexto
verifiableTask: Interpretar e usar phrasal verbs com put em contextos diferentes e explicar cada sentido

content.text: put on · put off · put up · put up with · put away · put down · put out · put through · put forward · put together · put aside · put across · put back.

pelo contexto e usar os principais.
